item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: unify device session verification status UI across current device and device details.

Plan: inspect existing device card/components and types/tests; add the shared localized status component; wire it into current device and details views; run relevant existing tests.
EOF
sed -n '1,240p' src/components/views/settings/devices/CurrentDeviceSection.tsx; sed -n '1,260p' src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetails.tsx; sed -n '1,220p' src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceSecurityCard.tsx; cat src/components/views/settings/devices/types.ts"
